This directly matches subagent/parallelization orchestration, though it's first-party documentation only. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of subagent parallelism working reliably, and no mention of a broader agent-to-agent (A2A) protocol beyond its own subagent/gateway mechanisms.
